kpis.name: Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE)
kpis.description: Composite measure of availability, performance, and quality that quantifies how effectively a line produces good product against planned time.
kpis.formula: OEE = Availability x Performance x Quality = (Run Time / Planned Production Time) x (Ideal Cycle Time / Total Count) x (Good Count / Total Count)

kpis.name: Throughput per Line / Shift
kpis.description: Number of good units produced per line or shift, indicating productive output over time.
kpis.formula: Good Count produced / Run Time

kpis.name: Cycle Time per Module
kpis.description: Average time to complete one module through the line, indicating process speed and bottlenecks.
kpis.formula: Total production time / Total modules produced

kpis.name: First-Pass Yield (FPY)
kpis.description: Percentage of units that pass all quality checks the first time without rework, a key indicator of process quality.
kpis.formula: Units passing first time / Total units started x 100

kpis.name: Rework Rate
kpis.description: Proportion of units requiring rework, signaling quality issues and hidden capacity loss.
kpis.formula: Units reworked / Total units produced x 100

kpis.name: Scrap Rate
kpis.description: Proportion of units scrapped as unrecoverable, directly tied to material and yield loss.
kpis.formula: Units scrapped / Total units produced x 100

kpis.name: Changeover Time
kpis.description: Average time to switch a line from one product/setup to another, a lever for flexibility and OEE.
kpis.formula: Time from last good A to first good B

kpis.name: Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF)
kpis.description: Average operating time between unplanned equipment failures, indicating reliability.
kpis.formula: Total operating time / Number of failures

kpis.name: Mean Time To Repair (MTTR)
kpis.description: Average time to restore equipment after a failure, indicating maintainability and spares readiness.
kpis.formula: Total repair time / Number of failures

kpis.name: Unplanned Downtime %
kpis.description: Share of planned production time lost to unplanned stoppages, a direct OEE and revenue driver.
kpis.formula: Unplanned downtime / Planned production time x 100

kpis.name: Schedule Compliance %
kpis.description: Extent to which actual production follows the planned schedule, indicating planning and execution discipline.
kpis.formula: Units produced to schedule / Planned units x 100

kpis.name: Planned vs. Emergency Maintenance Ratio
kpis.description: Ratio of planned to emergency maintenance work, reflecting how predictive the maintenance program is.
kpis.formula: Planned maintenance work orders / Emergency maintenance work orders

kpis.name: % Assets Streaming Data
kpis.description: Share of in-scope critical assets actively streaming data to the platform, measuring instrumentation coverage.
kpis.formula: Assets streaming data / Total in-scope critical assets x 100

kpis.name: Data Completeness %
kpis.description: Share of expected data points actually received within a period, indicating pipeline and sensor health.
kpis.formula: Data points received / Data points expected x 100

kpis.name: Data Latency (Machine to Dashboard)
kpis.description: End-to-end time from a machine event to its appearance on the dashboard, critical for real-time decisions.
kpis.target: < 5 s for control tower; < 1 s for operator HMI
kpis.formula: Dashboard event timestamp - Machine event timestamp

kpis.name: Edge Compute Uptime
kpis.description: Availability of edge compute nodes, on which local analytics and control depend.
kpis.formula: Edge node uptime / Total time x 100

kpis.name: Time to Instrument New Asset
kpis.description: Effort/time to bring a new asset online with full data streaming, indicating scalability and repeatability.
kpis.target: < 8 h per standard asset (down from days)
kpis.formula: Time from asset ready to data streaming validated

kpis.name: Vision QA Precision / Recall
kpis.description: Precision (trustworthiness of defect flags) and recall (share of true defects caught) of the vision QA model.
kpis.formula: Precision = TP/(TP+FP); Recall = TP/(TP+FN)

kpis.name: Model Retraining Frequency
kpis.description: How often models are retrained, indicating responsiveness to drift and process change.
kpis.target: >= 1 per quarter per production model (or drift-triggered)
kpis.formula: Count of production retraining events / period

kpis.name: Prediction Accuracy
kpis.description: Accuracy of predictive models (e.g., PdM failure prediction) against actual outcomes on a validation set.
kpis.formula: Correct predictions / Total predictions x 100 (or model-specific metric)

kpis.name: False Positive / Negative Rate
kpis.description: Rates of false alarms and missed detections, balancing operator trust against defect escape risk.
kpis.formula: FP = FP/(FP+TN); FN = FN/(FN+TP)

kpis.name: Model Deployment Cycle Time
kpis.description: Time from a validated model ready to production deployment, indicating MLOps maturity and agility.
kpis.formula: Production deployment time - Approval timestamp

kpis.name: Security Baseline Score
kpis.description: Composite score of OT cybersecurity posture against IEC 62443 target security levels across zones.
kpis.target: Meet target security level per zone (e.g., SL-T 2/3)
kpis.formula: Weighted conformance score across IEC 62443 requirements

kpis.name: OT Patch Compliance %
kpis.description: Share of OT systems patched within the defined risk-based patching SLA, indicating vulnerability management.
kpis.formula: Systems patched within SLA / Systems requiring patch x 100

kpis.name: Vulnerability Remediation Time
kpis.description: Average time to remediate identified vulnerabilities in OT systems, weighted by severity.
kpis.formula: Average (remediation date - discovery date) by severity

kpis.name: Security Incidents Detected / Blocked
kpis.description: Count of security events detected and blocked in the OT environment, indicating monitoring effectiveness.
kpis.target: Trend stable; 0 successful breaches; reduced repeat incidents
kpis.formula: Count(detected events) and Count(blocked events) by category

kpis.name: Program ROI Realization Ratio
kpis.description: Ratio of actual realized operational benefits (yield uplift, OEE gain, downtime reduction, energy savings) to cumulative program cost-to-date — tracks whether the investment is generating the projected returns in real operations
kpis.target: >= 1.0 by end of Phase 7 (investment fully recovered)
kpis.formula: Sum of verified operational benefits (Rs/year) / Cumulative program cost (Rs)
kpis.source: Benefits tracker reconciled with plant financial data; PMO ROI model

kpis.name: Cost per Connected Asset (CPA)
kpis.description: Average cost to connect one manufacturing asset to the data platform — including edge hardware, sensors, cabling, installation labour, and platform license allocation. Tracks deployment efficiency and validates scaling economics
kpis.target: <= target from business case (should decline per wave as architecture is reused)
kpis.formula: Total deployment cost for wave (hardware + labour + licenses) / Number of assets connected in wave
kpis.source: Program financial tracker; edge device register; deployment cost coding

kpis.name: Platform License Cost per Data Point per Month
kpis.description: Monthly cost of IIoT/historian/analytics platform licenses normalized per data point streaming — essential for validating scalability economics against the business case assumptions
kpis.formula: Total monthly platform license cost / Total streaming data points
kpis.source: Platform vendor invoice; tag/point register from data platform

kpis.name: Program Payback Period Tracking
kpis.description: Running estimate of the time required for cumulative program benefits to equal program costs — updated quarterly based on actual benefit realization vs plan; triggers governance review if payback extends beyond sponsor threshold
kpis.target: <= original payback target from business case (e.g., 18 months)
kpis.formula: Projected months until cumulative verified benefits >= cumulative program cost (linear interpolation of latest benefit run-rate)
kpis.source: PMO benefits tracker; program financial reports

kpis.name: Change Order Cost as % of Baseline Budget
kpis.description: Total value of approved change orders as percentage of the original baseline program budget — tracks scope stability and procurement/contract management quality
kpis.formula: (Sum of approved change order values / Baseline program budget) x 100
